buffer_chunk_size.description: Set the initial buffer size to read file data.

buffer_max_size.description: Set the limit of the buffer size per monitored file.

db.description: Specify the database file to keep track of monitored files and offsets.

db.compare_filename.description: This option determines whether to review both inode and filename when retrieving stored file information from the database.

db.journal_mode.description: Sets the journal mode for databases (wal).

db.locking.description: Specify that the database will be accessed only by Fluent Bit.

docker_mode.description: If enabled, the plugin will recombine split Docker log lines before passing them to any parser.

docker_mode_flush.description: Wait period time in seconds to flush queued unfinished split lines.

docker_mode_parser.description: Specify an optional parser for the first line of the Docker multiline mode.

event_batch_size.description: Set the maximum number of bytes to process per iteration for files monitored in event mode (files promoted from static to event-based monitoring).

exclude_path.description: Set one or multiple shell patterns separated by commas to exclude files matching certain criteria.

exit_on_eof.description: When reading a file, exit as soon as it reaches the end of the file.

file_cache_advise.description: Set the posix_fadvise in POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED mode.

generic.encoding.description: Set the non-Unicode encoding of the file data.

ignore_active_older_files.description: Ignore files that are older than the value set in ignore_older even if the file is being ingested.

inotify_watcher.description: Set to false to use file stat watcher instead of inotify.

key.description: When a message is unstructured (no parser applied), it's appended as a string under the key name log.

mem_buf_limit.description: Set a memory limit that the Tail plugin can use when appending data to the engine.

offset_key.description: If enabled, Fluent Bit appends the offset of the current monitored file as part of the record.

parser.description: Specify the name of a parser to interpret the entry as a structured message.

path.description: Pattern specifying a specific log file or multiple ones through the use of common wildcards.

path_key.description: If enabled, it appends the name of the monitored file as part of the record.

progress_check_interval.description: Set the interval for checking file progress.

progress_check_interval_nsec.description: Set the nanosecond component of the progress check interval.

read_from_head.description: For new discovered files on start (without a database offset/position), read the content from the head of the file, not tail.

read_newly_discovered_files_from_head.description: For newly discovered files after startup (without a database offset/position), read the content from the head of the file, not tail.

refresh_interval.description: The interval of refreshing the list of watched files in seconds.

rotate_wait.description: Specify the number of extra time in seconds to monitor a file once it's rotated in case some pending data is flushed.

skip_empty_lines.description: Skips empty lines in the log file from any further processing or output.

skip_long_lines.description: When a monitored file reaches its buffer capacity due to a very long line (buffer_max_size), the default behavior is to stop monitoring that file.

static_batch_size.description: Set the maximum number of bytes to process per iteration for the monitored static files (files that already exist upon Fluent Bit start).

tag.description: Set a tag with regexextract fields that will be placed on lines read.

tag_regex.description: Set a regular expression to extract fields from the filename.

thread.ring_buffer.capacity.description: Number of slots in the ring buffer for data entries when running in [threaded](/manual/4.2/administration/multithreading.md) mode.

thread.ring_buffer.window.description: Percentage threshold (1-100) of the ring buffer capacity at which a flush is triggered when running in [threaded](/manual/4.2/administration/multithreading.md) mode.

threaded.description: Indicates whether to run this input in its own [thread](/manual/4.2/administration/multithreading.md#inputs).

truncate_long_lines.description: When enabled, truncates lines that exceed the buffer capacity after input encoding conversion to UTF-8.

unicode.encoding.description: Set the Unicode character encoding of the file data.

watcher_interval.description: Set the interval for the watcher that monitors symbolic link rotation.

per_record_routing.description: When true, Fluent Bit evaluates route conditions for each record.

name.description: A unique identifier for the route.

default.description: Match records that did not match any earlier route.

op.description: Logical operator for combining route rules.

context.description: Location of the field used for route evaluation.

field.description: Field to evaluate, using Fluent Bit record accessor syntax.

op.description: Comparison operator applied to the selected field.

value.description: Value compared against the selected field. Arrays are valid for in and not_in.

rules.description: Routing rules to evaluate for this route.
